# Vectob OS 0.2 — experimental x86-64 live USB edition

This branch preserves Vectob OS 0.1/0.1.1 on main, which targets i386 UTM.

The GitHub Actions workflow builds an experimental minimal Debian XFCE live ISO for **x86-64 UEFI** using grub-mkrescue. This is a prototype, not yet boot-tested.

**Important: Secure Boot is NOT supported by this image.** GRUB generated by grub-mkrescue is not signed/trusted by Secure Boot. Do not flash it expecting to boot with Secure Boot enabled on the Lenovo. We need a validated shim + signed GRUB + trusted kernel chain, plus VM boot tests, before recommending it for your laptop.

The live system uses user `vector`, password `vector` (test only). No installer included. It does not automatically overwrite Windows drives. Do not use for sensitive data.

The downloadable ISO is uploaded as a GitHub Actions artifact if the build succeeds. Size below 1 GB is a target, not a guarantee; check actual artifact size before downloading. Xtool is not bundled or validated.
